Morgan Stanley Increased Stake in Telecom Argentina S A (TEO) by $42.79 Million as Market Valuation Declined; As Apple (AAPL) Valuation Declined, Shareholder Buckhead Capital Management Has Trimmed Position by $1.18 Million
May 8, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Morgan Stanley increased its stake in Telecom Argentina S A (TEO) by 672.93% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Morgan Stanley bought 1.19 million shares as the company’s stock declined 17.60% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.37M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.00M, up from 176,614 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Morgan Stanley who had been investing in Telecom Argentina S A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.06M market cap company. The stock decreased 6.04% or $1.639 $25.481. About 412,745 shares traded or 122.30% up from the average. Telecom Argentina S.A. (NYSE:TEO) has risen 43.04% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.49% the S&P500.
Buckhead Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 12.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Buckhead Capital Management Llc sold 6,967 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 47,336 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.01 million, down from 54,303 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Buckhead Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $939.50B market cap company. It closed at $185.16 lastly. It is down 19.49% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Morgan Stanley, which manages about $60.09 billion and $365.35 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Proshares Tr (EUM) by 190,892 shares to 140,388 shares, valued at $2.52M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Marine Prods Corp (NYSE:MPX) by 56,446 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 101,710 shares, and cut its stake in Teradyne Inc (NYSE:TER).
